infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ZeroTracker shares this phone's location with your fleet manager while a trip is running.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Choose "Always" so tracking continues when the screen is off. Sharing happens only while a trip is running.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion readings are used only to detect severe impacts and potholes during a trip.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Choose "Allow all the time" so tracking continues when the screen is off. Sharing happens only while a trip is running.
